home.hero_subtitle: We support families and children with autism spectrum disorders in Moldova through therapy, education, and community.
home.mission_text: We are a non-profit organization dedicated to improving the quality of life of children with autism and their families in the Republic of Moldova. We provide therapy services, educational programs, and community support.
home.service_therapy_desc: Applied behavior analysis to develop social and communication skills.
home.service_education_desc: Courses and materials tailored to each child's individual needs.
home.service_support_desc: Guidance and counseling for parents and caregivers.
home.service_integration_desc: Group activities and community inclusion programs.
home.cta_text: Your donation directly supports children and families who need help.

history.title: Our history
history.subtitle: A long journey together
history.founding_text: The organization was founded in 2010 by a dedicated group of parents and specialists who saw the lack of specialized services for children with autism in Moldova.
history.mission_text: We are guided by inclusion, respect, and excellence in everything we do. We believe every child deserves the opportunity to reach their full potential.
